_note: RULES OF THUMB, NOT SOURCED FACTS. Typical ranges for B2B SaaS / AI software used by estimator.py only when no sourced value exists in the research ledger. Every value taken from here is logged as type 'estimate', method 'benchmark_rule_of_thumb', confidence 'low' unless the agent replaces it with a sourced figure (pricing page, filing, survey with link). Ranges are deliberately wide; update them in your fork when you have better evidence.

smb.label_en: small and medium businesses, self-serve or inside sales
smb.label_ru: малый и средний бизнес, самообслуживание или телепродажи

mid_market.label_ru: средние компании, телепродажи и выездные продажи

enterprise.label_en: large enterprises and public sector, field sales
enterprise.label_ru: крупные компании и госсектор, прямые продажи

consumer.label_en: consumers / prosumers, app stores or web
consumer.label_ru: потребители / просьюмеры, магазины приложений или веб

acv.unit: USD per paying user per year

ai_adjustments._note: AI-heavy products (per-request inference cost) usually have lower gross margin than classic SaaS.

adoption._note: Share of the serviceable segment that buys a category product within the horizon — rule of thumb for a young category; replace with a sourced adoption survey when available.

valuation._note: Private / early-stage discount applied to listed-peer revenue multiples (illiquidity, size, stage). Rule of thumb.

it_spend_share_of_revenue._note: IT spend as share of revenue for retail / services companies — rule of thumb for a top-down cross-check

category_share_of_it_spend._note: share of IT spend that goes to one software category (e.g. workforce management) — rule of thumb

value_defaults._note: Rules of thumb for customer-value maths when no measured baseline exists (label as estimates).

hours_saved_per_unit_month._note: hours of manager / back-office time freed per unit (location, seat) per month by a workflow tool

automation_share_of_manual_time._note: share of the manual task time the product removes; manual time = hours saved / this share

loaded_cost_factor._note: employer cost over gross wage (payroll taxes, benefits)

value_capture_share._note: share of customer value a vendor can charge

first_year_ramp._note: share of the full benefit realised in year 1

deal_units._note: units (locations, seats) in one corporate deal

finance_defaults._note: Rules of thumb for the auto-built financial model; replace with the founders' plan when available.

developer_cost_vs_avg_wage._note: used only when no sourced developer wage exists

venture_risk_premium._note: premium over the risk-free rate for an early-stage company

ru._note: additional discount to US listed-peer multiples for a market with higher country risk and fewer exits

rd_share_of_revenue_final._note: rule of thumb: R&D at 20–40 % of revenue for a growing SaaS company in the last model year; the default team is scaled down when the market cannot carry it

offline_defaults._note: ONLY for offline dry runs with an empty ledger: order-of-magnitude assumptions so the pipeline completes. Every value is logged as method 'assumption', confidence 'low', and auto_pitch watermarks the deck 'offline draft — run the research loop'. Never ship a deck built on these.
